title: consistency-tower, cut/A3, and infinite-model expansion of G2-ZOO

statement_names.C_n: C_0=T and C_{n+1}=boxtimes(C_n), the iterated APS consistency tower
statement_names.Con_orb_n: C_n is not refutable, i.e. C_n not <= bot
statement_names.Con_flat_le_N: the checked initial C_0..C_N orbit is flat except for equality

B_detached_rosser_period_family.family: R_{2k} detached Rosser period preAPS, k=1..max_k

C_cut_boundary_diagnosis.minimal_failure: Adding one detached boxtimes-fixed point p preserves A1/A2/A4 but breaks A3 at x=y=p.
C_cut_boundary_diagnosis.repair: Deleting p returns the cycle model C_m, a genuine APS with the same flat consistency orbit.
C_cut_boundary_diagnosis.interpretation: A3 is the algebraic cut/collision closure missing from the detached Rosser fixed point layer.
